programmes.description: The Guardsman. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 28 year old Geoffrey Charles Dean was murdered by a railway fireman who stole £160 from the railway booking office.

programmes.title: There Was a Young Lady
programmes.description: 1953. Comedy. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Michael Denison, Dulcie Gray & Sydney Tafler. A diamond merchants' secretary gets fired by her new boss for being too efficient.

programmes.title: The History Of Mr Polly
programmes.description: 1949. Drama. Director: Anthony Pelissier. Stars John Mills, Betty Ann Davies, Megs Jenkins, Moore Marriott & Finlay Currie. Alfred reluctantly uses inherited money on two big ventures.

programmes.title: Camera Magic
programmes.description: 1947. A rarity from Castle Films when Eugene Castle was presumed to be in charge of operations. An insight behind the scenes of the 'magic making' of films and many 'tricks of the trade'.

programmes.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programmes.description: The Thorkil Ghost. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Barbara Mullen. A young man tells Robin of hidden treasure in a castle that his late father had an encounter with a Viking ghost.

programmes.title: Carrie's War
programmes.description: 2004. Drama. Director: Coky Giedroyc. Stars Alun Armstrong, Geraldine McEwan & Jack Stanley. Carrie and her brother are evacuated to Wales where they meet friends who make their time delightful.

programmes.title: The Cheaters
programmes.description: Knight of the Road. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Richard Vernon. Eastern Insurance pay £6,000 to Ken Northwood when his car is stolen but three other insurers have also paid out...

programmes.title: A Family At War
programmes.description: 1971. Clash By Night. Creator: John Finch. Stars John McKelvey & Keith Drinkel. A still-blind Phillip encounters an old enemy who once shot one of his comrades in the Spanish Civil War. (S2, E16)

programmes.title: Appointment In London
programmes.description: 1953. War. Director: Philip Leacock. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Ian Hunter & Dinah Sheridan. A strained British Wing Commander leads his squadron of Lancaster bombers into another dangerous mission.

programmes.title: Public Eye
programmes.description: How About It, Frank? 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. Stars Alfred Burke, Peter Childs & Ray McAnally. Ron Gash wants Marker as his new partner. But are Gash's methods compatible with Marker's?

programmes.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programmes.description: Caroline Munro is down in The Cellar Club ready to whisk you away to Hong Kong with the 1974 film Shatter, a co-production by Hammer Films and Shaw Brothers Studio.

programmes.title: Shatter
programmes.description: 1974. Action Drama. Director: Michael Carreras. Stars Stuart Whitman, Peter Cushing & Lung Ti. An international hitman is hiding out in Hong Kong after completing a contract on an African leader.

programmes.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programmes.description: Caroline Munro asks you to don your rain macs and camel hair coats next week, to travel once again outside the confines of the Cellar Club for a very special live event.

programmes.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Last Vampyre
programmes.description: 1993. Drama. Director: Tim Sullivan. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Roy Marsden. Sherlock Holmes investigates strange and tragic happenings in a village where an unusual man resides.

programmes.title: Sight Extended
programmes.description: A man with agoraphobia faces a startling transformation when a powerful AI turns his life into a game. Sci-fi thriller.

programmes.title: Sincerely, Yours, Truly

programmes.title: Pawparazzi
programmes.description: Family comedy sees a young starlet arrive on location with her pampered dog in tow - but she doesn't get the star treatment she's used to.

programmes.title: The Little Mermaid
programmes.description: A mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to become human in order to impress a prince. Animated adaptation of the 1989 classic, with the voices of Sonya Krueger, Courage and Steve Guttenberg

programmes.title: Spy Cat
programmes.description: Marnie, a pampered feline who only knows about real life from television, swaps a life of luxury for crime-fighting to clear her name when she and a group of other animals are mistaken for art thieves. Before long they embark on a rollercoaster ride of fun and adventure. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Erik Borner, Alexandra Neldel and Axel Prahl

programmes.title: Starting Up Love
programmes.description: Romance starring Anna Hutchison and Rocky Myers. City executive Jillian inherits her uncle's cabin retreat only to find its rugged maintenance man has been named joint owner.

programmes.title: Romance Retreat
programmes.description: Romantic drama starring Amanda Schull and Morgan David Jones. A journalist faces a dilemma when she finds herself on a yoga retreat with a handsome guy who happens to be involved in a scandal she's investigating.

programmes.title: Northpole
programmes.description: Seasonal fantasy starring Tiffani Thiessen and Max Charles. With everyone now seemingly too busy to enjoy Christmas the way they used to, Santa's home and livelihood come under threat. But young Kevin still believes, and together with his teacher and some new friends sets out to show just how magical the festive season can be.

programmes.title: Arctic Blast
programmes.description: A solar eclipse sends a blast of super-chilled air toward Earth, setting off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new ice age. Sci-fi thriller, starring Michael Shanks, Bruce Davison, Indiana Evans and Cinthia Burke

programmes.title: Zulu Dawn
programmes.description: Historical drama starring Burt Lancaster and Peter O'Toole. 1879: the king of the Zulu nation is goaded into making war so that the British Army can mobilise against him, but the Imperial forces foolishly underestimate the resourcefulness and passion of their adversaries.

programmes.title: Big Momma's House
programmes.description: Comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Nia Long. FBI agent Malcolm Turner is a master of disguise, but even his skills are put to the test when he has to impersonate larger-than-life southern matriarch Big Momma Pierce in order to catch a psychopathic bank robber.

programmes.title: Ideal Home
programmes.description: Paul Rudd and Steve Coogan -the kings of comedy come together for this must-see film. A big screen match made in heaven in this poignant and endearing comedy as they play a bickering, and flamboyant, couple (with an extensive erotic film collection) whose lavish life is thrown in to turmoil with the sudden appearance of their long-lost grandson. Will the pair be able to take on this new challenge?

programmes.title: Robocop: Prime Directives
programmes.description: Mini-series based on the sci-fi movie about a cyborg police officer. RoboCop stumbles across a cult whose members worship him as a god, but is tricked into believing he is a mere human - leaving him vulnerable to attack by the RoboHunters. Starring Page Fletcher

programmes.title: Date Movie
programmes.description: Romantic comedy spoof starring Alyson Hannigan and Adam Campbell. Julia Jones's parents would like her to settle down with a nice boy who shares her Greek-African-American-Indian-Japanese heritage. But Julia has her sights set on wet-but-handsome Englishman Grant Funkyerdoder, who has no idea what he's letting himself in for.

programmes.title: Father's Little Dividend
programmes.description: Comedy starring Spencer Tracy, Joan Bennett and Elizabeth Taylor. Stanley Banks is looking forward to some peace and quiet now that his daughter is married. But his plans are disrupted when she announces that she is going to have a baby.

programmes.title: A Stork's Journey
programmes.description: An orphaned sparrow embarks on the challenge of a lifetime when his adopted family of storks leave on their annual migration and he must keep up. Animated family adventure, with the voices of Cooper Kelly Kramer and Shannon Conley

programmes.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programmes.description: An overenthusiastic bee accidentally embarrasses an empress, and is forced to take part in a contest to save her hive. Animated adventure, with the voices of Coco Jack Gillies, Benson Jack Anthony and Richard Roxburgh

programmes.title: Legends of Oz: Dorothy's Return
programmes.description: Animated musical adventure featuring the voice of Lea Michele. After briefly returning home to Kansas, Dorothy Gale finds herself back in the magical land of Oz to help save her old friends from the evil Jester, who has stolen the broomstick of the late Wicked Witch of the West.

programmes.title: Tin Man
programmes.description: Part one of two. Reimagining of the Wizard of Oz. DG, a student and part-time waitress, finds herself whisked away to a magical realm known as the Outer Zone

programmes.title: Tin Man
programmes.description: Reimagining of the Wizard of Oz. Part-time waitress DG struggles to find her way through the Outer Zone, and spots a chance to discover the truth about her mother

programmes.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programmes.description: Three days before their wedding, Jess and Max are about to call it off. However, Jess begins to question her decision when Max's brother enlists the help of Billie to save the wedding, and in the process starts to fall for her. Romantic drama, starring Jocelyn Hudon, Jake Foy and Sam Robert Muik

programmes.title: A Perfect Christmas
programmes.description: Romantic fantasy starring Claire Coffee and Ryan McPartlin. Young executive Holly Maddux wakes after a fall to find that the hunky mannequin she admired in a department store window has come to life and is by her side. Love blossoms, but Holly soon discovers that being perfect all the time is hard work.

programmes.title: Krakatoa, East of Java
programmes.description: Disaster movie starring Maximilian Schell and Diane Baker. Tension is mounting aboard the Batavia Queen as it sails towards Krakatoa, a volcanic island near Java that's about to become the site of one of the biggest natural catastrophes ever recorded.

programmes.title: Big Momma's House 2
programmes.description: Comedy sequel starring Martin Lawrence and Nia Long. FBI agent Malcolm Turner once again goes under cover, this time to expose the suspected designer of a dangerous computer worm. Re-assuming the disguise of chubby grandma Big Momma, he infiltrates the man's family by posing as a nanny. But crime busting isn't easy when you've got endless household chores and three energetic kids to control.

programmes.title: The Professor
programmes.description: A lecturer discovers he has six months to live, and resolves to use the time he has left to the fullest, railing against authority and embracing a newfound hedonistic lifestyle. As the reality of his impending demise sinks in, he resolves to make amends for past mistakes and do what he can for the people who have supported him. Comedy drama, starring Johnny Depp, Rosemarie DeWitt and Odessa Young.

programmes.title: Robocop: Prime Directives
programmes.description: Mini-series based on the sci-fi movie about a cyborg police officer. RoboCop joins forces with his son in an attempt to stop evil genius Kaydick from destroying Delta City with a biotech virus. Starring Page Fletcher

programmes.title: Meet the Spartans
programmes.description: Spoof of 300 and other historic battle movies, starring Sean Maguire and Carmen Electra. King Leonidas of Sparta leads his men in a battle against troops led by Persian ruler Xerxes, while Leonidas's wife, Queen Margo, makes her own war effort.

programmes.title: Second Chorus
programmes.description: When perennial college students Danny O'Neill (Fred Astaire) & Hank Taylor (Burgess Meredith) are forced to make it on their own, the pair get jobs with Artie Shaw's band and reunite with ex-manager Ellen Miller (Paulette Goddard). Remastered for 4K UHD

programmes.title: Forever in My Heart
programmes.description: While in Ireland on an internship, Jenna falls in love with the Charlie, the son of the owner of the hotel she has been assigned to, but they end up going their separate ways. Five years later, she returns to Ireland and bumps into Charlie again - and it's immediately clear that they still have feelings for one another. Romantic drama, starring Merritt Patterson and Jack Turner

programmes.title: Love in Full Swing
programmes.description: When romance columnist Becks helps her best friend Casey look for love, she soon finds herself facing a dilemma - help Casey or risk opening her heart. Romantic drama, starring Sarah Smyth, Andrew Dunbar and Matthew Kevin Anderson

programmes.title: The First of the Few
programmes.description: Second World War biopic of RJ Mitchell, the designer of the Spitfire fighter plane, directed by and starring Leslie Howard, and also starring David Niven. Mitchell and his test pilot Geoffrey Crisp work tirelessly to develop the aeroplane that is destined to play a vital role in the battle against the Luftwaffe.
